changelog:
IMPORTANT: v2.0.0 uses a new signing key. To update from v1.1.0: download this APK from github.com/Shyam-vadgama/veyra-tv/releases/latest in a browser, uninstall Veyra TV, then install the downloaded APK. Saved playlist sources must be re-added once.

- Add, edit, delete and switch M3U/M3U8 and Xtream Codes playlists
- TV-friendly Playlists screen with D-pad controls
- Bundled playlists now seed only once, so deleted sources stay deleted
- Clear sync errors on Home and Playlists; HTTP sources are supported
- Room 5->6 migration for future in-place updates
- Signed release builds and Android CI
